scope: pre-dispatch, nonce, restart, and provider request-build bounded slice
findings: Provider request serialization failures are typed before observer and nonce authority and preserve their source cause.
Credential-reflection rejection is typed as provider.request_build with fresh-authorization restart.
HTTP and logical attempt ceilings are typed as workflow.recovery with no redispatch.
The logical-call ceiling is checked before any dispatch observer or nonce transition.
Registry public route and exact binding checks remain before secret lookup.
